parameters.name: seqtype
parameters.label: Sequence type (--seqtype)
parameters.help_text: Force input sequence type. Leave empty to auto-detect.

parameters.name: threads
parameters.label: Threads (--threads)
parameters.help_text: Number of CPU cores to use. Requires a Clustal Omega build with OpenMP support; on non-OpenMP builds, leave at 1.

parameters.name: auto
parameters.label: Auto settings (--auto)
parameters.help_text: Let Clustal Omega pick reasonable defaults based on input size (may override other settings).

parameters.name: full
parameters.label: Full distance matrix (--full)
parameters.help_text: Use the full distance matrix instead of the mBed heuristic. Slower but more accurate on small inputs.

parameters.name: iter
parameters.label: Iterations (--iter)
parameters.help_text: Number of combined guide-tree / HMM iterations. Higher = slower, potentially more accurate. Conflicts with --pileup.

parameters.name: full_iter
parameters.label: Full distance matrix during iteration (--full-iter)
parameters.help_text: Use the full distance matrix during iteration (slowish). Only meaningful when iterations > 0.

parameters.name: max_guidetree_iterations
parameters.label: Max guide-tree iterations (--max-guidetree-iterations)
parameters.help_text: Cap the guide-tree iteration count. Leave empty to follow --iter.

parameters.name: max_hmm_iterations
parameters.label: Max HMM iterations (--max-hmm-iterations)
parameters.help_text: Cap the HMM iteration count. Leave empty to follow --iter.

parameters.name: use_kimura
parameters.label: Kimura distance correction (--use-kimura)
parameters.help_text: Use Kimura distance correction when computing distances from already-aligned input.

parameters.name: percent_id
parameters.label: Output percent identity (--percent-id)
parameters.help_text: Convert distances into percent identities.

parameters.name: dealign
parameters.label: Dealign input (--dealign)
parameters.help_text: Remove any existing alignment (gaps) from input sequences before aligning. Useful when re-aligning a previously aligned file.

parameters.name: infmt
parameters.label: Input format (--infmt)
parameters.help_text: Force input file format. Leave empty for auto-detection.

parameters.name: cluster_size
parameters.label: Cluster size (--cluster-size)
parameters.help_text: Soft maximum number of sequences per mBed sub-cluster. Leave empty for default.

parameters.name: trans
parameters.label: Transitivity (--trans)
parameters.help_text: Use transitivity (0 = off, 1 or 2 = enabled).

parameters.name: pileup
parameters.label: Sequential pileup (--pileup)
parameters.help_text: Sequentially align sequences. Conflicts with iterations > 0.

parameters.name: maxnumseq
parameters.label: Max number of sequences (--maxnumseq)
parameters.help_text: Maximum allowed number of sequences. The run will abort early if this limit is exceeded. Leave empty for no limit.

parameters.name: maxseqlen
parameters.label: Max sequence length (--maxseqlen)
parameters.help_text: Maximum allowed sequence length. The run will abort early if any sequence exceeds this length. Leave empty for no limit.

parameters.name: mac_ram
parameters.label: MAC RAM limit in MB (--MAC-RAM)
parameters.help_text: Maximum RAM (in MB) for the MAC alignment stage. Leave empty for default.

parameters.name: output_order
parameters.label: Output order (--output-order)
parameters.help_text: Order sequences in output like the input file or like the guide tree. Leave empty for default.

parameters.name: wrap
parameters.label: Line wrap (--wrap)
parameters.help_text: Number of residues per line in the output. Mainly affects Clustal/Stockholm formats.

parameters.name: residuenumber
parameters.label: Show residue numbers in Clustal output (--residuenumber)
parameters.help_text: Print residue numbers. Only takes effect when the output format is Clustal.
